import json, statistics, time, math
import numpy as np
from notebooks.raft_markov_quality_benchmark import node_config_for, VM_PROFILES, make_cluster, raft_protocol, replacement_strategy
from powder.monte_carlo import MonteCarloConfig, MonteCarloRunner
from powder.simulation import Seconds
from powder.simulation.distributions import days
p=next(x for x in VM_PROFILES if x.name=='Spot'); RUNS=5000
for n in (3,5):
 cfg=node_config_for(p); runner=MonteCarloRunner(MonteCarloConfig(num_simulations=RUNS,max_time=Seconds(days(7)),stop_on_data_loss=False,parallel_workers=1,base_seed=2200000+n*100000))
 t0=time.perf_counter(); res=runner.run(make_cluster(n,cfg),replacement_strategy(cfg),raft_protocol()); wall=time.perf_counter()-t0
 a=np.asarray(res.availability_samples); q=np.quantile(a,[0,.001,.01,.05,.5,.95,.99,.999,1])
 print(json.dumps({'n':n,'runs':RUNS,'wall_s':wall,'mean':float(a.mean()),'std':float(a.std(ddof=1)),'quantiles':q.tolist(),'below_0.99999':float(np.mean(a<.99999)),'below_0.99':float(np.mean(a<.99)),'below_0.9':float(np.mean(a<.9)),'zero_unavail':float(np.mean(a==1.0))}),flush=True)

import json, statistics, time, math
from scipy.stats import t
from notebooks.raft_markov_quality_benchmark import node_config_for, VM_PROFILES, make_cluster, raft_protocol, replacement_strategy
from powder.monte_carlo import MonteCarloConfig, MonteCarloRunner
from powder.simulation import Seconds
from powder.simulation.distributions import days
TARGET=(0.999990,0.999999); RUNS=1000
for p in VM_PROFILES[1:]:
  for n in (3,5,7):
    cfg=node_config_for(p)
    runner=MonteCarloRunner(MonteCarloConfig(num_simulations=RUNS,max_time=Seconds(days(7)),stop_on_data_loss=False,parallel_workers=1,base_seed=1204000+(VM_PROFILES.index(p)*100000)+n*10000))
    t0=time.perf_counter(); res=runner.run(make_cluster(n,cfg),replacement_strategy(cfg),raft_protocol()); wall=time.perf_counter()-t0

import json, statistics, time, math
from scipy.stats import t
from notebooks.raft_markov_quality_benchmark import node_config_for, VM_PROFILES, make_cluster, raft_protocol, replacement_strategy
from powder.monte_carlo import MonteCarloConfig, MonteCarloRunner
from powder.simulation import Seconds
from powder.simulation.distributions import days

TARGET=(0.999990,0.999999)
PILOT={3:0.9999979443021239,5:0.9999980628856023,7:0.9999979773285199}
BATCHES=10; RUNS=1000
for n in (3,5,7):
    p=VM_PROFILES[0]; cfg=node_config_for(p); rows=[]
    total_start=time.perf_counter()
    for b in range(BATCHES):
        runner=MonteCarloRunner(MonteCarloConfig(num_simulations=RUNS,max_time=Seconds(days(7)),stop_on_data_loss=False,parallel_workers=1,base_seed=904000+n*10000+b*RUNS))
        t0=time.perf_counter(); res=runner.run(make_cluster(n,cfg),replacement_strategy(cfg),raft_protocol()); wall=time.perf_counter()-t0
        xs=res.availability_samples; mean=float(statistics.mean(xs)); sd=float(statistics.stdev(xs))
        half=float(t.ppf(0.995,RUNS-1)*sd/math.sqrt(RUNS)); lo=mean-half; hi=mean+half
        rows.append({'mean':mean,'sd':sd,'half':half,'lo':lo,'hi':hi,'wall':wall,'zeros':sum(x==1.0 for x in xs)})
    r=rows[0]
    print(json.dumps({
      'nodes':n,'selected_batch':{'runs':RUNS,'wall_ms':r['wall']*1000,'us_per_sim':r['wall']/RUNS*1e6,'mean':r['mean'],'std':r['sd'],'ci99_half_width':r['half'],'ci99_low':r['lo'],'ci99_high':r['hi'],'inside_target_band':bool(TARGET[0] <= r['lo'] and r['hi'] <= TARGET[1]),'contains_10000_run_pilot_mean':bool(r['lo'] <= PILOT[n] <= r['hi']),'delta_from_pilot':r['mean']-PILOT[n],'zero_unavailability_runs':r['zeros']},
      'ten_batch_check':{'target_containment_count':sum(bool(TARGET[0] <= x['lo'] and x['hi'] <= TARGET[1]) for x in rows),'pilot_mean_coverage_count':sum(bool(x['lo'] <= PILOT[n] <= x['hi']) for x in rows),'mean_range':[min(x['mean'] for x in rows),max(x['mean'] for x in rows)],'half_width_range':[min(x['half'] for x in rows),max(x['half'] for x in rows)],'zero_run_fraction_range':[min(x['zeros'] for x in rows)/RUNS,max(x['zeros'] for x in rows)/RUNS],'median_wall_ms':statistics.median(x['wall'] for x in rows)*1000},
      'total_check_wall_ms':(time.perf_counter()-total_start)*1000
    }),flush=True)

experiments.source:
import time,json,gc
from notebooks.raft_markov_quality_benchmark import node_config_for,VM_PROFILES,raft_protocol,replacement_strategy
from powder.scenario import QualityLevel,build_markov_model
from powder.markov_solver import steady_state,availability
p=VM_PROFILES[0]; cfg=node_config_for(p); prot=raft_protocol(); strat=replacement_strategy(cfg)
quals=[QualityLevel.SIMPLIFIED,QualityLevel.NO_ORPHANS,QualityLevel.FULL]
for n in (3,5,7):
 for q in quals:
  if n==7 and q==QualityLevel.FULL: continue
  gc.collect(); t0=time.perf_counter(); m=build_markov_model([cfg]*n,prot,strat,q); t1=time.perf_counter(); pi=steady_state(m,backend='scipy'); t2=time.perf_counter()
  print(json.dumps({'n':n,'quality':q.name,'states':m.num_states,'nnz':m.Q.nnz,'build_ms':(t1-t0)*1000,'solve_ms':(t2-t1)*1000,'total_ms':(t2-t0)*1000,'availability':availability(m,pi)}),flush=True)

experiments.name: annual_sample_planning
experiments.source:
import math
from scipy.stats import t,norm
zs=norm.ppf(.995)
data={3:(3.3589747110246866e-6,0.999997804273381,2.720558417/1000),5:(7.828394913424543e-7,0.9999980166725173,5.1206035/1000),7:(7.824568542095849e-7,0.9999980015241545,8.043426709/1000)}
def need(s,e,minn=2):
 for n in range(minn,10_000_000):
  if t.ppf(.995,n-1)*s/math.sqrt(n)<=e:return n
for n,(s,mu,sec) in data.items():
 print('N',n)
 for e in (4.5e-6,1e-6,5e-7,1e-7):
  k=need(s,e)
  print(e,k,'min30',max(30,k),'py_s',max(30,k)*sec,'rust30x_s',max(30,k)*sec/30)
 uppermargin=.999999-mu
 lowermargin=mu-.999990
 e=min(uppermargin,lowermargin)
 k=need(s,e)
 print('inside',e,k,max(30,k),max(30,k)*sec)
 print('z approx',[(e0,(zs*s/e0)**2) for e0 in (4.5e-6,1e-6,5e-7,1e-7)])
p=.9999945;e=4.5e-6
print('bernoulli normal',zs**2*p*(1-p)/e**2)
print('zero failures lower99two',math.ceil(math.log(.005)/math.log(.99999)))

import time,json
from notebooks.raft_markov_quality_benchmark import node_config_for,VM_PROFILES,raft_protocol,replacement_strategy
from powder.scenario import QualityLevel,build_markov_model
from powder.markov_solver import steady_state,availability
cfg=node_config_for(VM_PROFILES[0])
t0=time.perf_counter(); m=build_markov_model([cfg]*7,raft_protocol(),replacement_strategy(cfg),QualityLevel.FULL); t1=time.perf_counter()
print(json.dumps({'phase':'built','states':m.num_states,'nnz':m.Q.nnz,'build_s':t1-t0}),flush=True)
pi=steady_state(m,backend='scipy'); t2=time.perf_counter()
print(json.dumps({'phase':'solved','solve_s':t2-t1,'total_s':t2-t0,'availability':availability(m,pi)}),flush=True)
